text:
priya: Heads-up — multiple support tickets and customer alerts came in ~10:12 UTC reporting 5xx / timeouts from the hosted inference API. High-volume customers seeing 504s and intermittent 502s. Opening a war-room here so we can coordinate. @oncall-sre please triage. :rotating_light:

oncall-sre: I'm on it. Reproducing now against prod gateway. Initial dashboard shows a latency spike and a bump in backend 5xx around 10:09-10:20 UTC. Top symptoms: increased queue depth on model workers, gateway 504s, and a bunch of `503 backend unavailable` in the gateway logs.

ana: Noted multiple alerts for kv-cache eviction rate increasing at the same time — prefix cache miss rate jumped. Could be cache thrash -> more KV fetches -> higher model load. Pulling KV cache metrics now.

michael: Throwing some quick repro curl to see the failure mode:

```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v1","input":"hello world","max_tokens":256}'
# response: 504 Gateway Timeout or 502 Bad Gateway intermittently
```

jorge: From logs (gateway tail):

```
2026-04-21T10:11:06.123Z gateway ERROR request_id=Rk9lX backend=worker-42 status=504 latency_ms=30001 reason="read timeout"
2026-04-21T10:11:06.124Z gateway WARN kv_cache miss prefix=usr_abc eviction=high
2026-04-21T10:11:07.001Z worker ERROR model-inference timeout token_process=20123 cpu_spin=true
```

support-bot: Notifying customers linked to alerts: INC-1729, INC-1730, KBA-555. Sent initial update template. :mailbox_with_mail:

priya: First-pass mitigation ideas? We should aim for low-impact, quick rollback where possible.

oncall-sre: Actions taken so far (10:25 UTC):
- Rolled back the backoff-window config we shipped in the gateway earlier today (was decreasing retry backoff too aggressively, causing retry storms).
- Enabled circuit-breaker at route level for noisy tenants (threshold -> 50 rps sustained failing).
- Applied temporary rate limit for model-large-v1 to reduce concurrent queue pressure.
- Pinned a small % of traffic to `redwood-small-v1` as fallback for critical customers.

michael: After the rollback, 504s dropped ~70% within 6 minutes. KV cache miss rate decreased slightly. But tail latency still higher than baseline. We need root cause beyond config.

ana: Digging deeper: the new backoff behavior reduced client-side delays but caused many clients to retry faster (backoff min lowered), increasing burstiness. That + a regression in KV cache LRU logic (eviction threshold miscomputed) produced hot eviction thrash, hitting model workers with many cold-start KV fetches. The KV issue appears to be a separate but coincident regression from a daemon release yesterday.

jorge: Confirmed: commit `ff9c3b2` to kv-cache service changed the eviction policy math. Reverting that commit on staging reproduces the eviction spike in our staging load test.

deploy-bot: rollback started for kv-cache service to `ff9c3b1` (previous stable) — rolling across 4 regions.

priya: Good. Let's list reproducible steps to validate locally and for the postmortem:
1) Start a small worker cluster and kv-cache service with commit `ff9c3b2` enabled.
2) Run the customer traffic profile generator (script: `tools/load-sim --profile=enterprise-burst --clients=500`).
3) Observe kv_cache miss_rate and eviction_count. Expect eviction_count > baseline by 5-10x.
4) Send direct requests to worker behind gateway to observe timeout patterns.

ana: Reproducer snippet for the load sim config: 
```
load-sim config: {
  "clients": 500,
  "burst_pattern": "spiky",
  "mean_qps": 2000,
  "model": "redwood-large-v1",
  "enable_retries": true,
  "client_backoff": {"min_ms": 50, "max_ms": 500}
}
```

michael: Next: action items we should track in the follow-up postmortem. I'll create a consolidated ticket after this thread. Proposed AIs: 
- AI-1 (michael): Update SDK default retry/backoff to be more conservative and add jitter. Due: 2026-04-28.
- AI-2 (ana): Fix kv-cache eviction math bug and add unit + load tests to prevent regression. Due: 2026-04-26.
- AI-3 (jorge): Add per-tenant queue depth and token-level dashboards in Console for early detection. Due: 2026-05-05.
- AI-4 (oncall-sre): Implement gateway-level adaptive circuit breaker that considers backend queue depth, not just error rate. Due: 2026-05-03.
- AI-5 (priya): Outreach / customer comms follow-up and SLA credits worksheet. Due: 2026-04-24.

priya: I'm writing the customer update now. Quick note: please add any technical details you want included.

oncall-sre: Observability follow-ups: add KV cache eviction alarm when eviction_rate > 100/min sustained for >2m, and a dashboard panel for eviction vs model queue depth.

ana: Also want to add a regression test to CI that runs `tools/load-sim` with a small burst profile after KV cache changes. That should have caught the eviction thrash.

michael: For immediate post-incident hygiene I'll do a quick blameless summary in #postmortems and link this thread + tickets. We should include timeline, mitigations, root cause, and AIs.

jorge: On the root-cause wording: two independent regressions converged — the gateway backoff config change (client-visible) and the kv-cache eviction bug (server-side). The combined effect produced retry storms -> cache thrash -> backend queue pressure -> 5xx/timeouts.

support-bot: Customers updated: INC-1729, INC-1730 set to "We mitigated the issue and are working on follow-up fixes". Will send targeted follow-ups after AI assignments.

priya: Any remaining blockers before we mark war-room as resolved?

oncall-sre: Rolling rollback fully deployed by 10:40 UTC. Metrics have normalized by 10:46 UTC but we will keep elevated monitoring for 72h. For now: no blockers.

ana: Quick note — I found a small logging flap that hid the exact eviction counts in earlier graphs (off-by-one in the prometheus label). I fixed the query and re-uploaded the charts. Please review in the postmortem.

michael: OK marking this thread as the canonical incident thread. I'll open PM-xxxxx postmortem doc with timeline and link to the tickets. Thanks everyone for the quick coordination. :clap:

priya: Thank you — nice work all. Follow-ups: check the AI tasks and update the status in two days.

jorge: Leaving a quick note for runbook updates: add sections on "detect KV eviction thrash" and "temporary rollback knobs".

support-bot: War room closed (automated note). Logged incident in tracker as INC-1741.

michael: Last: quick config snippet to revert if needed (store in runbook):
```
# gateway-backoff.conf (revert):
retry {
  enabled = true
  min_backoff_ms = 200
  max_backoff_ms = 2000
  jitter = true
}
```

priya: Closing notes: will post postmortem draft by EOD tomorrow. If anyone wants to add details, reply here before 18:00 UTC.

(Reaction summary: many :thumbsup: and :eyes: on the key messages)
